Entry.JapaneseText: やんちゃぼうず
Entry.EnglishText: Rascal
Entry.Notes: Info on Dio's title and how to unlock them https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Dio:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: 早く大人になりたいと、森に野原に駆け回るその姿は まるきり子ども。もう少し落ち着こう
Entry.EnglishText: In a rush for adulthood, yet he darts around the forest and fields like a child. Let's slow it down a little.
Entry.Notes: The phrasing here I think needs to be changed. I think it's more of a reprimand to him that he's still a child for trying to grow - Maxle

Entry.JapaneseText: パワーアップディオ
Entry.EnglishText: Powered Up Dio
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Maxwell

Entry.JapaneseText: 苦しい試練をくぐり抜け、覚醒したでっかい力、 どんな敵でもぶっ倒す、拳の音が凛と響くぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: A great power awakened after overcoming a difficult trial. No matter the foe, he'll strike them down with a roaring crack of his fists!

Entry.JapaneseText: 一つ大きくなった少年
Entry.EnglishText: A Boy Who’s Grown a Little
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat the Masked Man and Masked Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: 闇雲に進んできたけど、世界の怖さも美しさも知って ひとつ大きくなりました。でもゴールはまだまだ先
Entry.EnglishText: Moving forward blindly until now, the World's beauty and horrors have helped him grow just a bit. His goal is still far, far away.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界を救った少年
Entry.EnglishText: The Boy Who Saved the World
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Pluto

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界滅亡の危機に、伝説の戦士たちとともに挑む。 名誉よりも、仲間たちの信頼と想いを懸けて
Entry.EnglishText: Facing the impending doom of the world, he stands alongside the legendary warriors. Not for glory, but for the bonds forged with his comrades.

Entry.JapaneseText: 真実を知る少年
Entry.EnglishText: The Boy Who Knew the Truth
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Dhaos in Dhaos's Castle

Entry.JapaneseText: 辛く苦しく悲しい記憶が蘇る。忘れていけない過去、 償いきれない罪、少年は決断の道を選ぶ……
Entry.EnglishText: Sad, painful memories resurface. A past that mustn't be forgotten, a sin which cannot be atoned for, the boy chooses a decisive path.
Entry.Notes: I think the second sentence needs to be revised since the first two statements feel somewhat disjointed - I think there needs to be a transition word to connect them to the last statement - Maxle

Entry.JapaneseText: 青二才のつわもの
Entry.EnglishText: Novice Warrior
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 10

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１０、戦いに慣れ、強くなりたい欲も出てきた。 まだまだ成長過程、のびしろバツグン！
Entry.EnglishText: Level 10, you've gotten used to battles and begun to seek strength. You're still growing and the sky's the limit!
Entry.Notes: Should we use "At Level 10" or just "Level 10"? - Maxle

Entry.JapaneseText: そこそこなつわもの
Entry.EnglishText: Capable Warrior
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 30

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル３０、腕に自信がついてきた、今、一番戦いが 楽しい。そして一番油断する危険な時。気をつけろ！
Entry.EnglishText: Level 30, you're feeling confident in your skills and battling is a blast, but it's also all too easy to let your guard down. Be careful!

Entry.JapaneseText: 剛健なつわもの
Entry.EnglishText: Sturdy Warrior
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 60

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル６０、向かうところ、行く手を遮る敵はなし。 オレのポリシー、媚びない退かないへこまない！
Entry.EnglishText: Level 60, wherever you go, no enemy stands in your way. My motto - I'll never back down, you won't beat me!
Entry.Notes: Somewhat shortened "motto" - wordier would be something like "I won't bend the knee, back down, or lose!" with 'bend the knee' being a bit of a stretch for '媚びない' (suck up to)

Entry.JapaneseText: 凄絶なつわもの
Entry.EnglishText: Fierce Warrior
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 200

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル２００、そんなに強くなってどうすんのって、 道行く人に言われても、これもオレの生きがいだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Level 200, even if people on the street ask me what the point of THIS much strength is, it's just my way of life!

Entry.JapaneseText: コンボベイビー
Entry.EnglishText: Combo Baby
Entry.Notes: Event: Perform a 10-hit combo with Dio

Entry.JapaneseText: １０コンボ達成！ 攻撃繰り出せば、カ・イ・カ・ン。 叩いて斬ってこねくりまわせば新たな戦いの音がする
Entry.EnglishText: You've landed a 10-hit combo! Listen to those attacks - Kapow! As you strike, slash, and pummel, you'll be hearing new battle sounds ring out!

Entry.JapaneseText: コンボエキスパート
Entry.EnglishText: Combo Expert
Entry.Notes: Event: Perform a 50-hit combo with Dio

Entry.JapaneseText: ５０コンボ達成！ 攻撃繰り出し、連ねろ情熱の拳。 粋な技を展開し、ぱっと咲かせる戦いの華
Entry.EnglishText: You've landed a 50-hit combo! Let loose your attacks and string those strikes! Style on your foes with those artes and blossom on the the battlefield!

Entry.JapaneseText: コンボキング
Entry.EnglishText: Combo King
Entry.Notes: Event: Perform a 100-hit combo with Dio

Entry.JapaneseText: １００コンボ達成！ 連続攻撃繰り出しまくり、 ごめんまいったもうやめてと敵に言わせる無情の拳骨
Entry.EnglishText: You've landed a 100-hit combo! Your unrelenting barrage of attacks will make foes give up and beg you to stop.

Entry.JapaneseText: ベルセルク
Entry.EnglishText: Berserker
Entry.Notes: Event: Fight 256 battles on Hard difficulty or higher

Entry.JapaneseText: 昼も夜も戦いに明け暮れ、重ねに重ねた勝利の石積み。 背後に築かれる敗者の山を忘るべからず
Entry.EnglishText: Consumed by battle day and night, you've built a tower of hard-won victories. Never forget the mountain of the defeated that keeps rising behind you.

Entry.JapaneseText: グミ嫌い
Entry.EnglishText: Gel Hater
Entry.Notes: Event: Do not use Gels during battle until after the fight with Maxwell. I Hate Gels! (genis title)

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦闘で使うヤツは甘いぜ！ ストイックかつシビアに 戦いに臨む者はグミなんて使わないのだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Gels are for the soft and weak! Those who conduct battle with stoicism and rigor needn't bother with gels.

Entry.JapaneseText: 猛獣使い
Entry.EnglishText: Beast Tamer
Entry.Notes: Event: Capture 30 monsters

Entry.JapaneseText: 荒れ狂う魔物たちを手なずけ、可愛がり、ともに戦う。 でも甘やかしてばかりはダメ。アメとムチは必要だゾ
Entry.EnglishText: Tame the wild beasts, care for them, and battle alongside them. But don't pamper them - you'll need both the carrot and the stick.

Entry.JapaneseText: パーフェクトレイヤー
Entry.EnglishText: Perfect Roleplayer
Entry.Notes: Event: Get all costumes; could change Cosplayer to "Roleplayer" to keep consistent? Pegi: yes I made the change to roleplayer, it makes sense

Entry.JapaneseText: 剣士、魔法使い、格闘家。どんなものにだってなれる、 コスチュームの数だけ無限大の未来が広がる！
Entry.EnglishText: Swordsman, mage, fighter - you can become anything! There are as many possibilities as there are costumes!

Entry.JapaneseText: ちゃんぴょん
Entry.EnglishText: Champion
Entry.Notes: Coliseum: Dio (Expert). Note:might be a double entendre

Entry.JapaneseText: 豪腕の無頼漢どもをなぎ倒し、辿り着いたぜ、 ナンバーワン！ 闘技場のスターはまぶしく輝く
Entry.EnglishText: He wiped the floor with those powerful brutes and made it to the top - to Number One! He's the shining star of the arena!
Entry.Notes: Term: Coliseum Need another way to describe "brutes" - 無頼漢ども

Entry.JapaneseText: 照れ屋さん
Entry.EnglishText: Shy Boy
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 51: Hot Spring (2)

Entry.JapaneseText: うぶな少年には、まだ色々と早いことがたくさんある。 あんな事とかこんな事とか、あまつさえこんな事も
Entry.EnglishText: There are many experiences simply too soon for an innocent boy. Y'know, things like this or that...

Entry.JapaneseText: うに
Entry.EnglishText: Sea Urchin
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 76: Ushi Ushinin nin (Ko-Kowz-z)

Entry.JapaneseText: 騙し騙され、巻き上げられて、カモにされた人の好い バカ正直さと引き換えにいただきました、残念
Entry.EnglishText: He fell for it hook, line, and sinker. He paid the price for his gullible and naive nature. What a shame.
Entry.Notes: Needs context of the event itself. Pegi: Seems to be a quest similar to vesperia where you give and antlionman items and you get stuff in return

Entry.JapaneseText: クロスマスター
Entry.EnglishText: Cross Master
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 84: Obtain all medals and receive the Super Gin Medal from Norn at Ethos's House.

Entry.JapaneseText: 胸に輝くバッジよりも数千倍価値がある、自分の足で 稼いだ成果、心に刻んだ勲章は太陽よりも神々しい
Entry.EnglishText: A thousand times more valuable than any badge on your chest — the hard-earned fruits of your labor, a medal etched within your heart, shines more brilliant than the sun.

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔界を操る男
Entry.EnglishText: Demon Mastermind
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 31, 32, 79 (Form pacts with all demons)

Entry.JapaneseText: 闇にうごめく不吉なヤツらの魂すらもその手に握る。 次はあなたの枕元で、ケケケと笑う声を響かすかも
Entry.EnglishText: In his hands he holds the very souls of the sinister fiends that writhe in the dark. Perhaps you'll hear his diabolic cackling in your sleep...

Entry.JapaneseText: 寡黙な男
Entry.EnglishText: Silent Man
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_137: 男は黙って～２

Entry.JapaneseText: ムダ口を叩くばかりじゃ能はない。男は静かに黙って、 精進してこそ、真理の冒険者となれるのさ
Entry.EnglishText: There's no point in idle chitchat. A man must stay calm, quiet, and focused in order to become a seeker of truth.
Entry.Notes: May need slight tweak based on skit

Entry.JapaneseText: ツルツルニンジャッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Slick Ninja
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_146: つるにんじゃ Probably needs more context, but "Slick Ninja" tentatively

Entry.JapaneseText: 忍びとは忠義に生き、忠義に死ぬ。いざ、地獄の果て までお供つかまツル！ 裏切り者はツルし上げだ！
Entry.EnglishText: A Ninja lives and dies by loyalty. Come, I'll serve you to the depths of Hell! Traitors will be hung!
Entry.Notes: Literal translation for now, should try to work pun(s) in based on final context.

Entry.JapaneseText: かにかにどこかに
Entry.EnglishText: Out and CRAB-out
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_161: かにの気持ち. Note: another pun-ish title

Entry.JapaneseText: 横に横に歩いていって、目的地には辿り着けない。 永遠に横へ横へ……っておーい！ どこへ行くカニ？
Entry.EnglishText: You'll never reach your destination if you keep walking side to side. Forever side to side...Hey! Where are you off to Mr. Crab?
Entry.Notes: Made an attempt at a crab pun in the title for now

Entry.JapaneseText: おすましさん
Entry.EnglishText: Prim and Proper
Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title for Mel https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Mel:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: 少し背伸びしてお化粧してみたり、怖いものなんて ないようなふりをする。そんな大人ぶりたい年頃
Entry.EnglishText: Stepping outside her comfort zone, playing with make-up and pretending like nothing scares her. She's at the age when she wants to act all grown-up.

Entry.JapaneseText: パワーアップメル
Entry.EnglishText: Powered Up Mel
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Maxwell

Entry.JapaneseText: 苦しい試練をくぐり抜け、覚醒した気高き力、 大切なモノを守るための支えになるね、きっと
Entry.EnglishText: A refined power awakened after overcoming a difficult trial. It will serve as her source of strength to protect all she holds dear.

Entry.JapaneseText: 勇気がめばえた少女
Entry.EnglishText: Courageous Girl
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat the Masked Man and Masked Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: 不安だらけで飛び出して、右も左もわからない。 でも、思い切って飛び込めば案外うまくいくもんだ
Entry.EnglishText: She set out into the world full of anxiety, not knowing left from right, but things have a way of working out surprisingly well if you just dive in.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界を救った少女
Entry.EnglishText: The Girl Who Saved the World
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Pluto

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしたちの住む美しい星、それをしっかり守るため、 ５年１０年１００年先もいつでも呼んで。駆けつける
Entry.EnglishText: For the beautiful planet we call home, she staunchly protects it. Whether it be 5, 10, or even 100 years from now, she'll come running.

Entry.JapaneseText: 運命を選び取る少女
Entry.EnglishText: The Girl Who Chose Her Destiny
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Dhaos in Dhaos's Castle

Entry.JapaneseText: 重く科せられた過酷な天の矛先、逃げずにまっすぐ 向かい合う。運命の横顔はいつでも非情だけど
Entry.EnglishText: She faced the heavy hand fate dealt her without looking back. Destiny is ever a cruel mistress.
Entry.Notes: Needs to be checked

Entry.JapaneseText: これから強くなる乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Mighty Maiden
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 10

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１０、戸惑いつつも、戦い方を体で感じ取る。 技も体も、まだまだ発展途上。がんばれ！
Entry.EnglishText: Level 10, though still uncertain, she's beginning to get a feel for how to fight. Her technique and stamina are still works in progress, keep at it!

Entry.JapaneseText: 強くなった乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Mightier Maiden
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 30

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル３０、か弱き乙女の腕から繰り出す攻撃は 結構、堂に入っている。可憐に敵を一撃ノックアウト
Entry.EnglishText: Level 30, the delicate maiden's attacks are becoming quite formidable. She'll gracefully knock her foes out with a single blow.

Entry.JapaneseText: まだまだ強くなる乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Mightiest Maiden
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 60

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル６０、真面目に戦い続けた結果がここにある。 でも、まだ階段を登りやめない少女の明日はどっち？
Entry.EnglishText: Level 60, the results of countless earnest-fought battles are here. But what lies beyond tomorrow for the girl who hasn't stopped climbing?

Entry.JapaneseText: このうえなき乙女
Entry.EnglishText: Umatched Maiden
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 200

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル２００、極め磨きぬかれた戦いの技を、誰もが 二度見していく。可愛いのに強いと評判間違いなし！
Entry.EnglishText: Level 200, onlookers do a double take at her skills, polished to perfection. Adoreable yet tough, she's surely known the world over.

Entry.JapaneseText: ビューティーレイヤー
Entry.EnglishText: Cosplay Beauty
Entry.Notes: Event: Get all costumes

Entry.JapaneseText: オシャレ大好き、女の子。どれを着ようか、 毎日小一時間は迷っている。お気に入りはどーれ？
Entry.EnglishText: A girl obsessed with dressing up. She agonizes for hours over what to wear each day. Now, which one is her top pick?

Entry.JapaneseText: アイテムコレクター
Entry.EnglishText: Item Collector
Entry.Notes: Fill the Collector Book by 84%

Entry.JapaneseText: ささいな宝箱も見逃さず、まめに買い物におでかけ。 集めに集めたアイテム。使えばもっと旅は楽しい
Entry.EnglishText: Never missing a treasure chest, checking out every shop, collecting item after item. Using them makes your journey all the more enjoyable!

Entry.JapaneseText: モンスターコレクター
Entry.EnglishText: Monster Collector
Entry.Notes: Fill the Monster Book by 85%

Entry.JapaneseText: 色んな敵と戦った、その記録は旅の道のりそのもの。 これでどんな敵にも負けないゾ
Entry.EnglishText: You've fought all sorts of enemies - your battles themselves are a record of your journey. You won't lose to any foe!

Entry.JapaneseText: 未来の巨匠
Entry.EnglishText: Maestro from the future
Entry.Notes: Get all the recipes

Entry.JapaneseText: 食卓に、バラエティ豊かなメニューをお届け。でも、 お嫁さんにはならないよ。目指すは、一流シェフ！
Entry.EnglishText: There'll be tons of food for this table for two. But she's not here as your date - she aims to be a top-tier chef!
Entry.Notes: I'd like someone to proofread this one. The second sentence literally uses wife.

Entry.JapaneseText: 回復嫌い
Entry.EnglishText: Healing Hater
Entry.Notes: Event: Do not use healing during battle until after the fight with Maxwell; this includes healing with other characters

Entry.JapaneseText: 痛いの痛いの、遠いお山までトンデケー！ これが 最高の回復呪文。痛くてもじっと我慢の健気な子
Entry.EnglishText: Pain, pain, go away! This is the ultimate healing spell! She's a brave child who endures the pain without complaint.

Entry.JapaneseText: 乗り越える少女
Entry.EnglishText: She Who Overcomes
Entry.Notes: Event: Mel is in the battle party in the battle against Dhaos at Dhaos's Castle

Entry.JapaneseText: どんなに過酷な真実も、どんなに大きな不安も全部、 乗り越える強さで、すべての決着をつけに少女は赴く
Entry.EnglishText: Having the strength to overcome the harshest truths and worst fears, she sets out to settle things once and for all.

Entry.JapaneseText: うさギルダー
Entry.EnglishText: Bunny Buff
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 72

Entry.JapaneseText: ぴょんぴょんうさちゃんを愛でられる資格。 目指せ、ブリーダー！ でも…ネコのほうが好きだな
Entry.EnglishText: A certified lover of bouncy-bunnies. One day I'll become a breeder! But on second thought, I'm more of a cat person...
Entry.Notes: Tried to work in the wordplay with the title, could leave it as (Bunny Guilder?) and put the buff in the description for added alliteration (certified bouncy-bunny buff).

Entry.JapaneseText: かわいいメイド!?
Entry.EnglishText: A Cute Maid!?
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 09

Entry.JapaneseText: いつでも笑顔でお出迎え、楽しく話してお見送り。 いってらっしゃいませ、ご主人さま！？
Entry.EnglishText: She always greets you with a smile and sees you off with cheerful words. Enjoy your day, my master!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女弟子
Entry.EnglishText: Witch's Apprentice
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 53

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔女とは魔術ではなく、生き方そのもの！ マネをするには型破りすぎる美女魔女の教えだけど
Entry.EnglishText: Being a witch isn't about magic, it's a way of life! But following this beautiful yet eccentric witch's lifestyle might be a tad too much...

Entry.JapaneseText: まだまだこれから
Entry.EnglishText: We Still Have a Long Way to Go
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 50: Hot Spring (1)

Entry.JapaneseText: 若干１３歳、みんな成長過程、横のあの子の大きさが 気になるお年頃。でも、まだまだこれからこれから♪
Entry.EnglishText: At the age of 13, you can't help but compare how the girls around have developed. But you've still got plenty of time ahead of you♪
Entry.Notes: May need to rewrite this one

Entry.JapaneseText: 優しい法術師
Entry.EnglishText: Kind Cleric
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_140: ディオで実験 Maxle - Would it be Mage or Sorcerer rather than "Methodist"? Pegi - Changed to Cleric

Entry.JapaneseText: みんなに愛され、頼りにされる法術師。 身も心も癒して一人前！ その情熱の原点に博愛あり
Entry.EnglishText: She's a beloved and dependable mage - treating both body and soul on her road to become a true master. Her passion comes from her love for all.

Entry.JapaneseText: ホウキライダー
Entry.EnglishText: Broomstick Rider
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_142: ホウキライダー

Entry.JapaneseText: 高度１万メートルのジェットストリームに翻弄されて 空を飛ぶ素敵！ 冷たい風さえ、気持ちいい
Entry.EnglishText: Tossed about by a jet stream 10,000 meters high into the sky while flying feels amazing! Even the cold wind feels great!

Entry.JapaneseText: ボロロンナース
Entry.EnglishText: Bororon Nurse
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_163: 危ない治療 I don't know how to translate ボロロンナース

Entry.JapaneseText: どんな病気もたちどころに治す、そんなナース。 ボロンナボヌリンで好き嫌いも治れば……いいね？
Entry.EnglishText: A nurse who can cure any ailment in an instant. If only Bororon could cure picky eating too... Wouldn't that be nice?
Entry.Notes: I don't know how to translate ボロロンナース
